name: Adversarial Game Tree Search
description: Compute optimal move in two-player zero-sum game using minimax with alpha-beta pruning.
input_format: Game state, legal moves, terminal condition, heuristic evaluation function
output_format: Optimal move and expected outcome under perfect play
steps: Apply minimax: maximise at agent nodes, minimise at opponent
Return root move with highest value

example.input: Tic-tac-toe, X to move, board half-filled
